model: Linear zero-offset NS-vacuum clock feedback with positive weighted, fixed channel delays; no finite-offset dynamics inferred

conventions.delays: D_nu>=0, L_nu=pi+D_nu, Omega_nu=2pi/L_nu; weights positive and normalized.
conventions.opening: b0=pi*(mean(Omega_nu^2)-1)/6>0; b0 and bulk A,B use the existing source/alpha convention.
conventions.coordinates: u=tau+chi,v=tau-chi; clocks r(s)=s+xi_R(s),l(s)=s+xi_L(s). C=A-B, S=A+B; P=d^3/dx^3+d/dx. xi_antisymmetric=(xi_R-xi_L)/2 and j_antisymmetric=(delta_J_R-delta_J_L)/2.
conventions.clock: xi_antisymmetric_prime(s)=[C(s+pi/2)+C(s-pi/2)]/(2*b0); differentiated clock equations alone must retain the original bulk/mouth integration constraints.

equations.characteristics: G_diff=P(lambda)+(1/(3b0))*mean[(lambda^2+Omega^2)*(1+exp(-pi*lambda))*(1+exp(-D*lambda))/(1-exp(-L*lambda))]; G_sum changes both plus signs to minus.
equations.transfer: With incoming per-pass source i_nu, D_A*xi=F_boundary-(1+exp(-pi*lambda))*mean[i_nu/(1-exp(-L_nu*lambda))], D_A=b0*lambda*G_diff. Initial-state and one-pass sources have different numerators.

proof.kernel: The periodic resolvent identity gives lambda*R_plus=4/L+(8/L)*sum_(n>=1) z*cos^2(n*pi^2/L)/(z+n^2*Omega^2). R_minus has no constant and replaces cos^2 by sin^2.
proof.subtraction: Multiplication by z+Omega^2 removes the n=1 vacuum pole. Dividing by (z+1)^2, subtracting the value and derivative at -1 and using b_L=pi*(Omega^2-1)/6 yields the displayed spectral identity. Its constant at positive infinity is b_L. Resonances use the continuous positive residue below, rather than substituting 0/0.
proof.antisymmetric_sign: Im(F_A)=-Im(z)*mean[sum c_n/abs(z+n^2*Omega^2)^2]; F_A>0 for real z>=0 since b0>0. Therefore G_diff has no zero with Re(lambda)>0.
proof.symmetric_sign: Im(F_S)=Im(z)*[b0+(8/3)*mean[L^-1*sum (n^2-1)*Omega^2*sin^2(n*pi^2/L)/abs(z+n^2*Omega^2)^2]]. This is strictly of the sign of Im(z), and F_S>0 for real z>=0. G_sum likewise has no right-half-plane zero.
proof.continuum: At any positive z0, each positive spectral sum equals its bounded closed form minus bounded b_L, uniformly for L>=pi. Tonelli therefore applies to any normalized positive delay distribution. The bounded ratio (z0+a)/(z+a), a>=0, on compact subsets off the negative real axis gives local uniform absolute convergence. Unbounded delays may produce a spectral cut; no isolated neutral-mode counting is asserted there.
proof.truncation: Numerics subtract cos^2/x+A*cos^2/x^2 and restore their exact Fourier sums, with A=2-Omega^2-z. B=2z-1-A(z-2), C=-z-A(1-2z), D=-Az. With x=n^2*Omega^2 and X=(N+1)^2*Omega^2, the remaining rational numerator is B*x^2+C*x+D over x^2*(x-1)^2*(x+z). Its absolute tail is at most8K/(15L*Omega^6*N^5), K=(abs(B)+abs(C)/X+abs(D)/X^2)/[(1-1/X)^2*(1-abs(z)/X)], requiring X>max(1,abs(z)). This follows from sum_(n>N)n^-6<=1/(5N^5). The sine tail is at most8*abs(z^2*(z+Omega^2))/[15L*Omega^6*(1-abs(z)/X)*N^5]. These are analytic truncation bounds, not interval bounds on floating-point arithmetic.

resonance.general_weight: At n*Omega=1: c_n=pi^2*(1-Omega^2)/(6L). n=1 contributes zero.
resonance.gauge: For a finite nonresonant ensemble, the eliminated C characteristic contains (lambda^2+1)^2, generically giving double +/-i roots. C=exp(ix) reconstructs zero; C=x*exp(ix) reconstructs i*exp(i*tau)*(sin(chi)+chi*sec(chi)), a bounded AdS-frame perturbation. At L=2pi*n,n>=2, F_A has a positive pole at z=-1 and one factor cancels. Transport poles, accidental degeneracies and homogeneous state modes require the uneliminated equations for complete neutral-mode counting; none changes the right-half-plane exclusion.

scope: Analytic absence of exponentially growing characteristic modes in this specified linear, zero-offset, free-NS-vacuum, common-mouth, fixed-delay leading-JT closure. This is not damping, an all-time response bound, nonlinear stability, robustness to a shifted/excited state, finite-collar dynamics, a solved nonspherical4D exterior or chronology protection. Multiplying transport denominators can add or hide neutral modes; no frequency sweep substitutes for the proof.
sources: https://arxiv.org/html/1807.04726v3: NS Casimir normalization and leading throat framework.
https://arxiv.org/pdf/math-ph/0412028: chiral stress transformation and positive-energy CFT input. The distributed-delay spectral identity and its application here are our derivation.
